heroBody: The AirPods Pro 3 is Apple's latest flagship earbud with the H3 chip, dramatically improved noise cancellation and built-in heart-rate sensing. In Singapore, the price varies significantly depending on where you buy: Apple authorised resellers hold the official list price, while Amazon.sg, Shopee Mall and Lazada LazMall official stores undercut it during promotional periods. Parallel importers offer the lowest sticker prices but without Apple Singapore warranty. This page pulls live Singapore listings from BuyWhere's catalog so you can see the current floor price, who is offering it, and whether the cheapest listing is a local set with full Apple warranty or an import.

highlightSectionTitle: What the AirPods Pro 3 delivers in 2026

highlights.title: Noise cancellation that justifies the upgrade
highlights.body: The H3 chip and redesigned ear tips with foam-infused silicone roughly double the effective noise cancellation of the Pro 2. On the Singapore MRT or a long-haul flight, low-frequency rumble drops noticeably further. If you commute daily or work in noisy environments, this is the single biggest reason to pay the premium over a discounted Pro 2.

highlights.title: Heart-rate sensing without a watch
highlights.body: A tiny infrared sensor tracks your heart rate during workouts and feeds data into Apple Fitness. For runners and cyclists in Singapore who do not want to wear an Apple Watch, this is a genuine differentiator. At a desk or on the couch, it is irrelevant — a discounted Pro 2 is the smarter buy.

highlights.title: Battery and charging
highlights.body: Listening time reaches about eight hours with ANC on, up from roughly six on the Pro 2. The case retains the U2 precision-finding chip and lanyard loop, charges via USB-C, and provides around thirty hours total. Some regions now ship without a cable in the box, so factor one in if you do not have a spare USB-C cable.

highlights.title: How Singapore pricing actually works
highlights.body: Singapore has no single dominant electronics retailer, so the same Apple product is sold simultaneously by the Apple Store, authorised resellers, marketplace official stores and parallel importers. Prices move with platform sale campaigns rather than with Apple, which is why a static 'best price' article goes stale within days. The live cards on this page pull current listings so you always see the real floor.

adviceSectionTitle: How to get the best AirPods Pro 3 price in Singapore
advicePoints: Check whether the listing says 'local set' or 'Apple Singapore warranty'. Parallel imports are cheaper but Apple Singapore stores will not service them under warranty — that is the trade-off for the lower price.
Time your purchase to Shopee and Lazada campaign days (9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12 and mid-month payday sales). Official stores discount deepest then, and the gap between list price and floor widens.
Amazon.sg often matches Shopee promotions within a few days. If you missed a flash sale on Shopee, check Amazon.sg for a similar price with easier returns.
Stack platform vouchers and bank cashback before comparing raw prices. A slightly higher sticker price with a Shopee voucher code and credit card cashback can beat the lowest listing.

Avoid listings well under the market floor with no reviews — they are usually pre-orders, refurbished units or bait-and-switch. Stick to Shopee Mall, LazMall, Amazon.sg (sold by Amazon), Challenger and Courts.
If you already own the AirPods Pro 2 and mostly listen at a desk, the upgrade is hard to justify. The money is better spent on replacement tips or a protective case for the set you already have.
faqSectionTitle: AirPods Pro 3 price in Singapore — common questions

faqs.question: What is the AirPods Pro 3 price in Singapore right now?
faqs.answer: The live cards at the top of this page pull current prices from Amazon.sg, Shopee, Lazada and authorised resellers every few minutes. On a typical non-sale day the floor price sits below the official list; during major platform campaigns it drops further. Check the cards above for the real-time number.

faqs.question: Is it cheaper to buy the AirPods Pro 3 from a parallel importer in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Parallel import listings carry the lowest sticker price, but Apple Singapore does not honour warranty on them. You get the shop's own warranty instead. If you value peace of mind and official service, buy a local set from an authorised reseller or an Amazon.sg listing marked as sold by Amazon.

faqs.question: When is the AirPods Pro 3 cheapest in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Historically during platform sale days: Shopee 9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12 and mid-month payday campaigns on Shopee and Lazada, with Amazon.sg matching within days. Outside those windows the live prices on this page show the current floor price across retailers.

faqs.question: Can I claim GST relief on the AirPods Pro 3 if I buy it in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Tourists can claim GST relief at participating retailers if they meet the minimum spend threshold and present their passport at the point of purchase. The eligible retailers and thresholds are listed on the eTRS website. Residents buying online are not eligible.

faqs.question: Does the AirPods Pro 3 work with Android phones in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Yes for audio and basic noise cancellation. Adaptive audio, hearing features, heart-rate sensing, seamless switching between devices and Find My all require an iPhone. Android users get less of the AirPods Pro 3 experience and may find a different brand offers better value.

categoryIntro.heading: Why AirPods Pro 3 prices vary across Singapore retailers
categoryIntro.body: Singapore's electronics retail landscape includes Apple's own store, authorised resellers like Challenger and Courts, marketplace official stores on Shopee and Lazada, Amazon.sg, and dozens of parallel importers — all selling the same AirPods Pro 3 at different prices at the same time. Official resellers hold the list price while marketplace stores discount during campaign periods, and parallel importers undercut everyone by shipping without Apple Singapore warranty. The live cards on this page pull straight from the catalog so you always see the real floor price rather than a stale snapshot.
